description.value: Domo Japan Grill & Sushi is a fast-food sushi and Japanese grill outlet in Courtenay, BC, listed in OSM at unit 209 with a Comox Valley area phone number. The business's former website domain now appears to redirect to an unrelated Korean restaurant in Vancouver, making independent verification of current operations difficult. A touring cyclist passing through Courtenay would need to verify the business is still operating before relying on it as a food stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places 'Domo Japan Grill & Sushi' in the Courtenay area of Vancouver Island (lat 49.709, lon -124.963, 250-area-code phone), but the fetched website content describes 'DELICIOUS KOREAN FOOD' with an address of 1738 Davie St, Vancouver, BC V6G 1W3 — a completely different business, cuisine, and city. The domain domosushi.ca appears to have been repurposed or acquired by a Korean restaurant in Vancouver, making the website unreliable as evidence for the OSM-listed business. No cycling-relevant amenity information can be confirmed.
concerns: Website domosushi.ca now shows a Korean restaurant at 1738 Davie St, Vancouver, BC V6G 1W3 — entirely different cuisine, city, and likely business; the domain may have been sold or hijacked.
